name: Masked Confessions
source:
You entered the room with questions. You'll leave with a mask in your hands... and your heart in his.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你带着疑问踏进房间。离开的时候，你手里会多一张面具…而你的心，会在他手里。
